name: Clear the Way
summary: Commander Ashlam Valorfist asks you to clear Skeletal Flayers and Slavering Ghouls from Sorrow Hill. He waits at Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands.

sections.title: At Sorrow Hill
sections.body: Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp asks you to thin the undead at Sorrow Hill. Skeletal Flayers and Slavering Ghouls are the creatures named, and their numbers are the obstacle there.

faq.answer: Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp gives the task.

faq.q: Where do I clear the way?
faq.answer: You are asked to kill Skeletal Flayers and Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill.

faq.q: Which creatures does Ashlam ask me to kill?
faq.answer: Commander Ashlam Valorfist names Skeletal Flayers and Slavering Ghouls.

faq.q: How many Skeletal Flayers and Slavering Ghouls?
faq.answer: The request names ten Skeletal Flayers and ten Slavering Ghouls.

faq.q: Where do I return to Ashlam?
faq.answer: Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands.

attribution: In-game quest text: Clear the Way
